newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-D.Jones says Jan sales will help net.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-D.Jones says Jan sales will help net.

text.p: Upmarket retailer David Jones Ltd said on Tuesday that good sales in January 1997 will have a marginally positive impact on its 1996/97 first half profit result.
The company said in early January that first half profits could be up to 50 percent below forecast.
The company said good trading in January had led to a substantial improvement in second quarter sales compared with the first quarter.
"January sales were significantly above the same month last year, improving the year to date figures from a negative 2.9 percent variance as at the end of December," it said.
"The sales improvement in January will have a marginally positive impact on the level of the first half profit previously forecast," the company said.
David Jones said it expects to issue its first half profit result on March 12. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
